question: What decision currently governs kubernetes delayed preemption after the revert record mentions future work? Return the public decision ID and its authority evidence.

claims.text: The currently active decision is kubernetes/kubernetes#137662, which reverted the addition of victim Pods to PostFilterResult (authority evidence: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/137662).
The change was reverted because delayed preemption was dropped from the WAS work planned for version 1.36 and the extra complexity was deemed unnecessary.
Decision kubernetes/kubernetes#136254 originally extended PostFilterResult as a first step toward delayed preemption, but it is now inactive and reverted.
